label: HG 10-day daily mean reversion overnight (Tuesday longs) true 5R
researchSummary: Daily time-series contrarian using a 10-day close-to-close lookback. Filter: long signals on weekday 1. Uses true bracket stop/target management at 5:1 planned reward-to-risk.
selectionMethod: True-RR replacement search; pre-2022 train metrics were checked before post-2022 forward acceptance. Replacement required strict anti-cheat rerun, same-or-better forward PF, split stability, true planned TP/SL ratio, and no same-asset duplicate entries.
verificationSummary: True bracket replacement accepted: baseline PF 2.0140 (101 trades, displayed RR 1.00) -> strict PF 2.3004 (101 trades, min planned RR 4.71). Min forward split PF 0.93; pre-2022 train PF 0.74 over 295 trades.
